picker.offlineNote: Their computer is offline. You can use it again once it is back online.

link.title: Provider Sharing
link.heading: Open This Link on a Computer
link.body: Provider sharing can only be requested and used in {{appName}} on a computer. Send the link to your computer and open it there, or paste it in Settings → Providers → Providers Shared with Me.
link.note: Share links expire 5 minutes after they’re created and work only once.
link.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the share link. Try again in a moment.

manage.loadFailed: Couldn’t load sharing details. Try again in a moment.
manage.notReady: Sharing isn’t available right now. Make sure you’re signed in and online; it will retry automatically.
manage.needsUpdate: Update Cindy on the provider’s computer to manage this share from your phone.
manage.offline: Can’t reach the provider’s computer right now. It will retry once the connection is back.

list.title: Providers I Share
list.emptyCopy: Keep Cindy online on a computer that allows remote control, and you can check quota, create share links, and handle requests here.
list.unreachable: Offline or remote control not allowed: {{devices}}. Computers appear here once they can be reached.
list.needsUpdate: Update Cindy on {{devices}} to manage sharing from your phone.
list.failed: Couldn’t load sharing details from {{devices}}. Pull down to try again.
list.note: Shares are stored on the provider’s computer, which needs to be online while you manage them.

pick.title: Choose a Provider to Share
pick.empty: No Providers to Share on This Computer
pick.footer: Only connected providers with “Allow remote use” turned on are listed. That switch is in Settings → Providers on that computer.

link.title: Share link
link.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the link. Select it and copy it manually.
link.footer: The link works once and expires 5 minutes after it’s created. After you send it, stay on this page: when their request arrives, compare the pairing code above before you approve.
link.gateInvocation: “Allow remote use” is off for this provider, so existing shares are paused and you can’t create new links.
link.gateMissing: This provider can’t be found on that computer. It may have been removed.
link.failed: Couldn’t create the share link. Try again in a moment.
link.needsUpdate: Creating links from your phone needs an update to Cindy on the provider’s computer or to the sharing service.

pending.title: Pending
pending.heading: {{name}} Requested Access to {{provider}}
pending.pairingHint: Before approving, you can ask them over the channel you sent the link through: “What pairing code do you see?” Approve if it matches.
pending.callout: Once approved, {{name}} can use {{provider}} models in their own sessions. The Agent runs on the computer hosting this provider and usage counts toward your {{provider}}. You can pause or remove access anytime in “{{provider}} · Remote & Sharing”.
pending.calloutGroup: Once approved, {{name}} can use {{provider}} models in their own sessions. The provider group picks the computer that runs the Agent, and usage counts toward your {{provider}}. You can pause or remove access anytime in “{{provider}} · Remote & Sharing”.
pending.calloutClaudeEmail: While {{name}} uses it, the Agent can see the email address you sign in to Claude with.
pending.calloutUnknown: If you don’t recognize this person, decline; the link stops working once declined.
pending.rejected: Declined {{name}}’s request; the link no longer works
pending.gone: This request was already handled elsewhere, withdrawn, or expired.
pending.uncertain: That computer didn’t respond, so the request may already be handled. Check the refreshed list.
pending.failed: That didn’t go through. Try again in a moment.
pending.checking: Checking the provider’s details. You can approve once that’s done.

computers.title: Computers and Quota
computers.footer: Quota comes from the accounts signed in on each computer and updates about once a minute. Computers shared by others don’t show quota here.

unavailable.provider-off: “Allow remote use” is off for this provider on that computer
unavailable.disconnected: Provider not connected or turned off

quota.unavailable: Can’t read this computer’s quota right now
quota.none: This provider has no quota information
quota.offline: This computer is offline, so its quota can’t be read
quota.needsUpdate: Update Cindy on this computer to see its quota
quota.unsupported: Quota can’t be read for this provider

members.title: People You Share With
members.empty: You haven’t shared with anyone yet. Create a share link and send it; once they request access and you approve, they’ll appear here.
members.footer: To pause or remove a share, or change the provider group, use Settings → Providers on a computer.
